name: BIG DOG
summary: BIG DOG is a breakout-style Expert Advisor that trades based on price breaking out of defined ranges, typically using session-based high/low levels to identify trading opportunities. It aims to capture momentum moves when price breaks out of consolidation zones during active market sessions.
summary_zh: BIG DOG是一个突破型EA，基于价格突破定义区间进行交易，通常使用时段高低点来识别交易机会。它旨在捕捉价格在活跃市场时段突破盘整区域时的动量行情。
strategy_analysis: BIG DOG策略的核心概念是基于区间突破入场，当价格突破前期设定的高点或低点时开仓。入场条件通常是在特定交易时段（如伦敦或纽约开盘时段）价格突破前期区间的高点做多，突破低点做空。出场条件包括止盈和止损设定，部分版本可能包含移动止损。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算手数。资金管理方面，该EA一般设有最大持仓限制和每日最大亏损限制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假突破导致的亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the BIG DOG strategy is range breakout entry, opening positions when price breaks above or below predefined high/low levels. Entry conditions typically involve price breaking above the session range high for long positions or below the session range low for short positions, often focusing on active trading sessions like London or New York opens. Exit conditions include take-profit and stop-loss levels, with some versions incorporating trailing stops to lock in gains. Position sizing generally uses fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation tied to account balance. Money management features typically include maximum position limits and daily maximum loss thresholds. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and effective in trending markets, but may generate significant losses from false breakouts during ranging or choppy conditions.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和优化
基于区间突破的思路在趋势市场中有较好的表现
通常设有时段过滤，避免低流动性时段交易
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and optimize
Range breakout approach performs well in trending markets
Typically includes session filters to avoid trading during low liquidity periods
cons: 震荡市中容易产生虚假突破导致连续亏损
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自适应切换策略
止盈止损比例可能不够灵活，未考虑波动率变化
cons_en: Prone to consecutive losses from false breakouts in ranging markets
Lacks market regime detection, unable to adaptively switch strategies
Take-profit and stop-loss ratios may be inflexible without volatility consideration
improvements: 增加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡市中减少交易频率
引入动态止盈止损机制，基于ATR调整止损距离以适应不同波动环境
improvements_en: Add market regime filters (such as ADX or volatility indicators) to reduce trading frequency during ranging markets
Introduce dynamic take-profit and stop-loss mechanisms based on ATR to adapt to different volatility environments

risk_points: 虚假突破在震荡市中可能导致连续亏损
固定止损可能无法适应不同波动率环境
缺乏资金曲线回撤控制机制
risk_points_en: False breakouts in ranging markets may lead to consecutive losses
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to different volatility environments
Lacks equity curve drawdown control mechanism

summary_en: BIG DOG is a breakout-style Expert Advisor that trades based on price breaking out of defined ranges, typically using session-based high/low levels to identify trading opportunities. It aims to capture momentum moves when price breaks out of consolidation zones during active market sessions.
